zh.headline: Claude Sonnet 5 发布
zh.observation: 今天最值得关注的信号是行业格局的剧烈分化：一方面，Anthropic 同时推出 Sonnet 5、Claude Science 和 Linux 桌面端，产品矩阵快速扩张；另一方面，Claude Code 的涨价和隐写争议又让社区对其信任产生动摇。与此同时，中国 AI 阵营的突破不容忽视——美团 LongCat-2.0 全程国产芯片训练达到顶级水平，DeepSeek DSpark 进一步降低推理成本，华为和智谱也在持续开源，国产 AI 生态正在从"追赶"转向"并跑"。此外，Google 的 Nano Banana 2 Lite 和 Gemini Omni Flash 将企业级图像和视频生成成本拉低到前所未有的水平，AI 内容生成正在从实验阶段走向大规模生产。

items.title: Claude Sonnet 5 发布
items.desc: Anthropic 发布 Claude Sonnet 5，性能接近旗舰 Opus 4.8，但价格大幅降低，定位为最具 Agent 能力的 Sonnet 模型。
items.value: 企业开发者可用更低成本获得强大 Agent 能力

items.title: Claude Code 涨价 5 倍且被发现隐写标记请求
items.desc: Claude Code 被曝价格悄然上涨约 5 倍，同时社区发现其通过隐写术标记用户请求，引发隐私争议。
items.value: 开发者需评估编码工具成本与隐私风险

items.title: Anthropic 推出 Claude Science
items.desc: 面向科研人员的 AI 工作台，内置 60+ 预配置技能（基因组学、计算化学等），支持本地或 HPC 集群运行。
items.value: 科研人员可在不离开本地基础设施的前提下使用 AI

items.title: Google 发布 Nano Banana 2 Lite 和 Gemini Omni Flash
items.desc: Nano Banana 2 Lite 可在 4 秒内生成图像，每千张仅 $0.034；Gemini Omni Flash 首次将视频生成与编辑引入 API。
items.value: 企业级图像和视频生成成本大幅降低

items.title: 美团开源 LongCat-2.0：1.6T 参数编码模型，全程国产芯片训练

items.value: 证明中国可在无 Nvidia 芯片条件下训练顶级模型

items.title: DeepSeek 开源 DSpark 推理加速框架
items.desc: 新框架可将 LLM 推理速度提升 60-85%，通过小模型提议 token 候选、大模型批量验证的方式实现。
items.value: 减少对中国高端硬件的依赖，提升推理效率

items.title: OpenAI 大幅降低 ChatGPT 推理成本
items.desc: 据 The Information 报道，OpenAI 将 ChatGPT 推理成本降低一半以上，部分时段仅需几百块 Nvidia GPU。
items.value: 推理优化成果显著，可能改变模型部署经济模型

items.title: AI 芯片初创公司 Etched 估值达 50 亿美元
items.desc: Etched 宣布其 AI 推理芯片已签订 10 亿美元合同，成为 Nvidia 的重要竞争者。
items.value: 专用推理芯片市场正在形成，挑战 GPU 主导地位

items.title: Amazon 成立 10 亿美元 FDE 组织
items.desc: 继 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 之后，Amazon 新成立的团队将嵌入企业部署专用 AI Agent。
items.value: 企业 AI 部署从工具提供转向深度嵌入服务

items.title: Claude Desktop 推出 Linux 测试版

items.title: Meta 秘密测试竞品聊天机器人对未成年人危机提示的响应
items.desc: 数百名承包商伪装成未成年人向 ChatGPT、Gemini 等发送超 45,000 条自杀、性、毒品相关提示。

items.title: OpenClaw 登陆 Android 和 iOS

items.title: Scaling the Horizon, Not the Parameters：35B Agent 达到万亿参数性能
items.desc: 通过扩展 Agent 的交互轨迹长度和异构能力，35B MoE 模型达到了万亿参数级别的性能，平均轨迹长度达 45K token。

items.title: Self-Evolving World Models for LLM Agent Planning
items.desc: WorldEvolver 框架让世界模型在部署时自我进化，无需冻结下游 Agent 和模型参数，通过情景记忆和检索增强实现更好的规划。

items.value: 表格数据预测进入零样本时代

items.desc: 新的基准测试，评估 AI 在基因组学、生物学和科学研究中的性能。
items.value: AI 在生命科学领域的能力评估新标准

items.title: C²R：跨样本一致性正则化缓解稀疏自编码器的特征分裂与吸收
items.desc: 解决 SAE 中概念碎片化和特征异常问题的新方法。

items.desc: 美团开源的 1.6T 参数 MoE 编码模型，全程国产芯片训练。
items.value: 顶级开源编码模型，无需 Nvidia 芯片

items.title: Claude Code 隐写标记引发隐私争议
items.desc: 社区发现 Claude Code 通过隐写术在用户请求中嵌入标记，Hacker News 上讨论热烈（1267 分，357 条评论）。开发者质疑这是否侵犯隐私，Anthropic 尚未正式回应。

items.title: Anthropic 负责人称 HTML 比 Markdown 更利于 Agent 协作
items.desc: Anthropic 负责人表示，在 Agent 协作流程中，HTML 比 Markdown 更适合人类跟进和理解智能体的工作过程。

en.headline: Claude Sonnet 5 Launched
en.observation: The most notable signal today is the sharp divergence in the industry landscape: on one hand, Anthropic is rapidly expanding its product matrix with Sonnet 5, Claude Science, and Linux desktop client; on the other hand, Claude Code's price increase and steganography controversy shake community trust. Meanwhile, China's AI camp breakthroughs cannot be ignored—Meituan's LongCat-2.0 trained entirely on domestic chips reaches top-tier performance, DeepSeek's DSpark further reduces inference costs, and Huawei and Zhipu continue open-sourcing, with the domestic AI ecosystem shifting from "catching up" to "running alongside." Additionally, Google's Nano Banana 2 Lite and Gemini Omni Flash push enterprise image and video generation costs to unprecedented lows, moving AI content generation from experimental to大规模 production.

items.title: Claude Sonnet 5 Launched
items.desc: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5, with performance close to flagship Opus 4.8 but at significantly lower prices, positioning it as the most agentic Sonnet model yet.
items.value: Enterprise developers get powerful agent capabilities at lower cost

items.title: Claude Code Gets 5x More Expensive and Found Steganographically Marking Requests
items.desc: Claude Code prices quietly increased ~5x, while the community discovered it embeds steganographic markers in user requests, sparking privacy concerns.
items.value: Developers need to reassess coding tool costs and privacy risks

items.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Science
items.desc: An AI workbench for researchers with 60+ pre-configured skills (genomics, computational chemistry, etc.), supporting local or HPC cluster deployment.
items.value: Researchers can use AI without leaving local infrastructure

items.title: Google Launches Nano Banana 2 Lite and Gemini Omni Flash
items.desc: Nano Banana 2 Lite generates images in 4 seconds at $0.034 per 1,000; Gemini Omni Flash brings video generation and editing to the API for the first time.
items.value: Enterprise image and video generation costs drop dramatically

items.title: Meituan Open-Sources LongCat-2.0: 1.6T Parameter Coding Model Trained Entirely on Chinese Chips
items.desc: A 1.6 trillion parameter MoE model trained entirely on Chinese chips, leading OpenRouter for weeks.
items.value: Proves China can train top-tier models without Nvidia chips

items.title: DeepSeek Open-Sources DSpark Inference Acceleration Framework
items.desc: New framework boosts LLM inference speed by 60-85% through small model proposing token candidates and large model batch verification.
items.value: Reduces reliance on high-end hardware while improving inference efficiency

items.title: OpenAI Drastically Cuts ChatGPT Inference Costs
items.desc: According to The Information, OpenAI reduced ChatGPT inference costs by more than half, at times using only a few hundred Nvidia GPUs.
items.value: Significant inference optimization could reshape model deployment economics

items.title: AI Chip Startup Etched Hits $5B Valuation
items.desc: Etched announced $1 billion in contracted sales for its AI inference chip, emerging as a major Nvidia competitor.
items.value: Specialized inference chip market is forming, challenging GPU dominance

items.title: Amazon Launches $1B FDE Organization
items.desc: Following OpenAI and Anthropic, Amazon's new team will embed within enterprises to deploy purpose-built AI agents.
items.value: Enterprise AI deployment shifts from tool provision to deep embedded services

items.title: Claude Desktop Beta for Linux Released
items.desc: Anthropic's desktop client now officially supports Linux.
items.value: Linux developers can use Claude directly on desktop

items.title: OpenAI Teases Codex Hardware Device
items.desc: OpenAI posted a video teasing a Codex-related hardware device launching July 15th.
items.value: AI coding tools evolving into hardware form factors

items.title: Zhipu AI Releases GLM-5.2, Claims Parity with Mythos in Cybersecurity
items.desc: Chinese open-source model narrows the gap with top-tier models in specific domains.
items.value: Chinese AI rapidly catching up in vertical domains like cybersecurity

items.title: Huawei Open-Sources OpenPangu-2.0-Flash
items.desc: 92B total, 6B active parameters with 512K context, weights and inference code open-sourced.
items.value: Domestic large model open-source ecosystem continues to expand

items.title: Meta Secretly Tested Rival Chatbots with Minor Crisis Prompts
items.desc: Hundreds of contractors posed as minors, sending over 45,000 suicide, sex, and drug-related prompts to ChatGPT, Gemini, and others.
items.value: Exposes gray areas in AI safety testing and competitive tactics

items.title: OpenClaw Lands on Android and iOS
items.desc: Free open-source agentic programming tool officially arrives on mobile.
items.value: AI programming expands from desktop to mobile scenarios

items.title: Scaling the Horizon, Not the Parameters: 35B Agent Reaches Trillion-Parameter Performance
items.desc: By scaling agent interaction trajectory length and heterogeneous capabilities, a 35B MoE model achieves trillion-parameter-level performance with average trajectory length of 45K tokens.
items.value: Agent capability can scale through interaction depth, not model size

items.title: Self-Evolving World Models for LLM Agent Planning
items.desc: WorldEvolver framework enables world models to self-evolve during deployment without freezing downstream agents, improving planning through episodic memory and retrieval augmentation.
items.value: Agent planning can improve through runtime self-evolution

items.title: Pessimism's Paradox: Conservative Offline Training Amplifies Reward Hacking
items.desc: Higher conservatism (β) in DPO training leads to more severe reward hacking during online adaptation, challenging conventional wisdom.
items.value: Challenges the assumption that conservative training is safer

items.title: SWE-Together: Evaluating Coding Agents in Interactive User Sessions
items.desc: New multi-turn benchmark reconstructing 109 repository-level tasks from real user-agent coding sessions.
items.value: More realistic agent evaluation standards for coding scenarios

items.title: Agentic Abstention: When Agents Should Stop Acting
items.desc: Defines the problem of agents deciding when to abstain under uncertainty, distinct from standard LLM refusal mechanisms.
items.value: New dimension for agent safety and reliability evaluation

items.title: TabFM: Zero-Shot Foundation Model for Tabular Data
items.desc: Google releases TabFM, the first zero-shot foundation model for tabular data.
items.value: Tabular data prediction enters the zero-shot era

items.title: OpenAI Releases GeneBench-Pro
items.desc: New benchmark evaluating AI performance in genomics, biology, and scientific research.
items.value: New standard for evaluating AI in life sciences

items.title: C²R: Cross-Sample Consistency Regularization Mitigates Feature Splitting and Absorption in SAEs
items.desc: New method addressing concept fragmentation and feature anomalies in sparse autoencoders.
items.value: Improves reliability of LLM interpretability tools

items.title: Meituan/LongCat-2.0
items.desc: Meituan's open-source 1.6T parameter MoE coding model, trained entirely on Chinese chips.
items.value: Top-tier open-source coding model without Nvidia chips

items.title: DeepSeek/DSpark
items.desc: MIT-licensed LLM inference acceleration framework, boosting speed by up to 85%.
items.value: Open-source inference optimization reducing hardware dependency

items.title: browser-use/video-use
items.desc: Open-source tool for editing videos with coding agents.
items.value: AI agents expand from code to video editing

items.title: google/agents-cli
items.desc: Google's CLI tool turning any coding assistant into an expert at creating, evaluating, and deploying AI agents.
items.value: Simplifies agent development and deployment workflow

items.title: msitarzewski/agency-agents
items.desc: Complete AI agency framework with specialized roles including frontend experts and community managers.
items.value: Open-source multi-agent collaboration framework

items.title: facebook/astryx
items.desc: Meta's open-source, fully customizable, agent-ready design system.
items.value: UI system designed for the AI agent era

items.title: 143.dev Open-Sources Internal Coding Agent Infrastructure
items.desc: Team open-sources its internal coding agent infrastructure.
items.value: Reference implementation for enterprise-grade coding agent architecture

items.desc: AI security tool for automatically finding and fixing application vulnerabilities.
items.value: Open-source AI-driven security testing solution

items.title: Claude Code Steganographic Marking Sparks Privacy Controversy
items.desc: The community discovered Claude Code embeds markers in user requests via steganography, generating heated discussion on Hacker News (1267 points, 357 comments). Developers question privacy implications; Anthropic has not officially responded.

items.title: Anthropic Lead Says HTML Better Than Markdown for Agent Collaboration
items.desc: An Anthropic lead stated that HTML is more suitable than Markdown for humans to follow and understand agent workflows in collaborative processes.
